# requirements_text_decoder.txt
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Pinned dependencies for converting MedGemma 4B text decoder to TFLite
# via the LiteRT Generative converter (STABLEHLO_COMPOSITE ops).
#
# Tested environment:
#   Kaggle TPU v5e-8 notebook (Python 3.12, ~100 GB RAM)
#   OR any Linux machine with >= 32 GB RAM
#
# Install:
#   pip install -r requirements_text_decoder.txt
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Core conversion stack
tensorflow-cpu              # TFLite flatbuffer ops support
litert-torch==0.8.0         # LiteRT Generative API (Gemma3 decoder builder + converter)
ai-edge-torch               # Optional: used by convert_ai_edge_torch.py (XNNPACK path)

# Model loading
safetensors                 # Load HuggingFace .safetensors weights
huggingface_hub             # snapshot_download + HfApi upload
transformers                # AutoTokenizer + AutoModelForCausalLM (ai_edge_torch path only)

# Utilities
torch                       # PyTorch (weight manipulation)
numpy
psutil
py-cpuinfo

# NOTE: For the ai_edge_torch path (convert_ai_edge_torch.py) you also need:
#   pip install transformers torch
# The HF model loads do NOT require litert-torch's Gemma3 decoder module.
